author: @Vas
source: Original complete relative_arithmetic_group_equiv contract from MazurTheorem Order13IntegralPicardRelativeArithmeticGroupEquivPublic.lean, Apache-2.0, Vas and contributors. The entire original statement is retained, including the exact structural scalar map, canonical relative group-law instance and actual literal function field. The proof now composes the Proved public literal-fibre group compatibility with a Proved public comparison of two Picard representations and the already Proved public existential arithmetic field equivalence. It imports no private arithmetic-constructor cache and supplies no arithmetic dictionary, genus, rank, cardinality or finiteness hypothesis. Reuses original official Anthropic FLT Picard, curve and divisor-class APIs at exact upstream pin 6e837e75355538c7f80bab5b956861e86c4eacc2. The complete original closed kernel type is checked against both the solution and public statement; native, strict and full frontend checks pass with standard axioms only. Named downstream consumers: the same integral family’s rational and mod-3/mod-5 arithmetic groups, torsion specialization and rational rank comparison. The public place-foundation Definition is imported explicitly so that the literal function-field alias in the unchanged statement is visible independently of implementation caches.

This is a derived nonvanishing transfer result, not a claim of the sharp Ramanujan–Petersson bound.
